pair._check: ABC coder-vs-expert PABAK, AC1 and intervals reproduce rev_pabak.csv (claude, openai rows)

a11.note: Class assigned by reading each stored verified quote; E only where the quote concerns the state of the environment the agent acts in. Borderline = plausible alternative reading; the *_borderline_all_D / _E counts give both bounds.

not_established.definition: fallback cells = resolve_cell status 'not_established' (no level reaches two cross-family verified supporters and no cross-family pair of raw 0s) plus 'na_rejected_as_zero' (an NA that lacks a cross-family second NA). Both coders raw 0 is 'established_zero' and is NOT in the set. Both coders NA is 'na_accepted' and is NOT in the set.

reported_zero.note: REPORTED = 0 means resolved final level 0 (NA cells are not applicable and leave the denominator). 'both verified zero' = effective 0 for both coders, which includes cells where a raw credit was removed by quote verification.

item_association.scope: Items are the ABC items and the BetterBench criteria on exactly the 'common' cells of the coder-pair kappas (expert, Claude and OpenAI all scored; effective scores; ABC binary, BetterBench 0-3 exact match). Per item: raw agreement of the coder pair, raw agreement of each coder with the expert, and their mean (coder-expert). Spearman rho across items between coder-pair and coder-expert agreement; benchmark bootstrap (2,000 resamples, seed 20261004, percentile 95% CI) recomputes every item statistic in each resample; an item absent from a resample is dropped for that resample. Pooled = the ABC and BetterBench items together; benchmarks are resampled separately within each instrument (the two benchmark sets differ), so the pooled ranking mixes two scales and is secondary.

ablation_agent_without_a11.definition: Agent columns of paper/tables/rev_ablation.tex recomputed on A1-A10 (A11 dropped) for every rule row of that table, with the same code path (revision_rq12.audit_levels -> rq1_rq2.module_summary, 2,000 benchmark bootstrap resamples, percentile 95% intervals, seed 20261004). The table prints rounded point percentages only; intervals are given here.

union.label: Union: max of the two verified scores

raw.label: Resolved rule on raw scores (no quote verification)
